# Test de Villaseñor 
La description du test se trouve dans l'article suivant (Avariance ratio test of fit for Gamma distributions Auteur : José A. Villaseñor, Elizabeth González-Estr)

## Cas 1 :  Processus Observés avec inspections périodiques (régulier)

```{r}
if (!require(goft)) {
  install.packages("goft")
  library(goft)
}
```


```{r}
gof_villasenor_reg <- function(dx) {
    resul <- gamma_test(dx)
     print(resul)
    if(resul$p.value < 0.05) {
        cat("p-value =", resul$p.value, " REJET H0")
    } else {
        cat("p-value =", resul$p.value, "Non rejet H0")
    }
}

```

```{r}
# Simulation du processus régulier
set.seed(123)
N <- 50
dt_eq <- 1
a_test <- 3
b_test <- 0.5

t <- seq(0, N * dt_eq, by = dt_eq)
x <- numeric(length(t))
for (i in 2:length(t)) {
  x[i] <- x[i-1] + rgamma(1, shape = a_test * dt_eq, rate = b_test)
}
dx <- diff(x)

# Application du test de Villaseñor
resultat1 <- gof_villasenor_reg(dx)

```

## Cas 2 :  Processus Observés avec inspections apériodiques (irrégulier)


```{r}
# Gamma Bridge (Pont Gamma)

gamma_bridge <- function(t, x, a, dt_eq) {
  
  if(any(diff(t) <= 0)) stop("Les temps doivent être strictement croissants")
  if(a <= 0) stop("a doit être positif")
  
  Np <- floor(max(t) / dt_eq)
  t_eq <- seq(dt_eq, Np * dt_eq, by = dt_eq)
  x_eq <- numeric(Np)
  
  for (i in 1:Np) {
    
    ti <- t_eq[i]
    
    sup_i <- which(t >= ti)[1]
    t_sup <- t[sup_i]
    x_sup <- x[sup_i]
    
    if (sup_i == 1) {
      t_inf <- 0
      x_inf <- 0
    } else {
      t_inf_candidate <- t[sup_i - 1]
      
      if (t_inf_candidate > (i - 1) * dt_eq) {
        t_inf <- t_inf_candidate
        x_inf <- x[sup_i - 1]
      } else {
$        t_inf <- (i - 1) * dt_eq
        x_inf <- if (i > 1) x_eq[i - 1] else 0
      }
    }
    
    # alpha1 <- a * (ti - t_inf)
    # alpha2 <- a * (t_sup - ti)
    
    alpha1 <- a * max(ti - t_inf, 1e-10)  #  Pour Éviter 0
    alpha2 <- a * max(t_sup - ti, 1e-10) 
    
    
    
    # Vérification 
    if (alpha1 <= 0 || alpha2 <= 0) {
      stop(paste("Paramètres bêta non positifs:", alpha1, alpha2))
    }
    
    y <- rbeta(1, alpha1, alpha2)
    x_eq[i] <- x_inf + (x_sup - x_inf) * y
  }
  
  return(data.frame(time = t_eq, value = x_eq))
}

```


```{r}
# Fonction de tri

tri_sample <- function(dt, dx, dt_eq) {
  
  N <- length(dt)
  
  dt_c <- dt
  dx_c <- dx
  
  dt_s <- numeric(N)
  dx_s <- numeric(N)
  
  max_i <- which.max(dt_c)
  dt_s[1] <- dt_c[max_i]
  dx_s[1] <- dx_c[max_i]
  
  dt_c <- dt_c[-max_i]
  dx_c <- dx_c[-max_i]
  
  for (i in 2:N) {
    
    cum_time <- sum(dt_s[1:(i - 1)])
    diffs <- (cum_time + dt_c) - i * dt_eq
    
    valid <- which(diffs >= 0)
    
    if (length(valid) > 0) {
      choix <- valid[which.min(diffs[valid])]
    } else {
      choix <- which.max(diffs)
    }
    
    dt_s[i] <- dt_c[choix]
    dx_s[i] <- dx_c[choix]
    
    dt_c <- dt_c[-choix]
    dx_c <- dx_c[-choix]
  }
  
  return(list(dt = dt_s, dx = dx_s))
}
```

# Estimation du paramètre a :  Méthode des moments


```{r}
estimer_a <- function(t, x) {
  
  dt <- diff(t)
  dx <- diff(x)
  
  m_hat <- sum(dx) / sum(dt)
  n_hat <- sum((dx - m_hat * dt)^2) /
           (sum(dt) - sum(dt^2) / sum(dt))
  
  return(m_hat^2 / n_hat)
}
```

```{r}
gof_villesenor_irreg <- function(x, t, 
                            a_ref = NULL,
                            dt_eq = NULL) {
  
  dt <- diff(t)
  dx <- diff(x)
  
  if(is.null(dt_eq)) dt_eq <- mean(dt)
  
  tri <- tri_sample(dt, dx, dt_eq)
  t_tri <- c(0, cumsum(tri$dt))
  x_tri <- c(0, cumsum(tri$dx))
  
  if(is.null(a_ref)) a_ref <- estimer_a(t_tri, x_tri)
  
  interp <- gamma_bridge(t_tri, x_tri, a_ref, dt_eq)
  dx_eq <- diff(c(0, interp$value))
  
  resultat <- gamma_test(dx_eq)
  
  if(resultat$p.value < 0.05) {
    cat("p-value =", resultat$p.value, "Rejet H0")
  } else {
    cat("p-value =", resultat$p.value, "Non Rejet H0")
  }
  
  return(resultat)
}

```

# Application 1: Processus Gamma
```{r}
# Génération des données irrégulières
N <- 50
dt_eq <- 1
a_true <- 2
b_true <- 1

t <- sort(runif(N, 0, N * dt_eq))
t <- c(0, t)

x <- numeric(length(t))
for(i in 2:length(t)){
  x[i] <- x[i-1] + rgamma(1, shape = a_true * (t[i]-t[i-1]), rate = b_true)
}

# Test de Villasenor
resultat <- gof_villesenor_irreg(x = x, t = t, dt_eq = dt_eq)
print(resultat)
```


# Application à un jeu de données réelles

```{r}
# Charger les données
library(nlme)
data(Fatigue)

head(Fatigue)


# Extraire un chemin (Path 1)
path1 <- subset(Fatigue, Path == 1)
t <- path1$cycles * 1e6  # cycles en millions
x <- path1$relLength     # longueur relative de fissure

# Test
resultat_villa <- gof_villesenor_irreg(x = x, t = t, dt_eq = 10000)
print(resultat_villa)
```
